findings.summary: Failure-first coverage omits required self-confidence and changed-model/prompt downgrade fences.
findings.details: The task packet explicitly requires self-confidence and changed model/prompt failure-first tests. The implementation carries selfConfidence as input data but does not validate it, and the focused brain-maintenance tests do not assert either a low/invalid confidence fence or an Autopilot downgrade when the modelPromptPair changes. This leaves false-green room for unsafe proposals or stale Autopilot eligibility to pass the focused proof.
